cases.prompt: We're a 50-person startup with Postgres and Snowflake -- help us design a data pipeline architecture from scratch, covering ingestion, transformation, and orchestration.
How do I fix a Kafka consumer that's stuck rebalancing every few seconds?
Airflow or SSIS for a SQL-Server-heavy shop that also wants to add some Python-based pipelines later -- what should we pick?
Our Airflow scheduler's DAG parsing takes 45 seconds and tasks are queuing up -- how do we speed that up?
Our Airflow 3.x DAG has a task stuck in 'deferred' state forever even though the sensor condition is clearly true -- how do we debug this?
We're trying to decide whether to move our SSIS packages to Airflow or Azure Data Factory -- which is the better target?
An SSIS package fails with DTS_E_OLEDBERROR on the OLE DB destination during a nightly load -- how do I read the SSISDB execution report to find the root cause?
We want to move our legacy SSIS packages to a cloud-native orchestrator -- Airflow or ADF?
Should our new analytics engineering team build models in dbt Core or just do everything in Spark? We're mostly SQL-first with under 1TB of data.
My dbt incremental model with a merge strategy is duplicating rows on reruns -- what's wrong?
My dbt incremental model using the merge strategy is producing duplicate rows after a full-refresh followed by an incremental run -- how do I fix the unique_key config?
How do I set up a CI job in dbt Cloud that only builds modified models using state:modified+?
We want to set up an Advanced CI job in dbt Cloud that shows a data diff between the PR branch and production before merging -- how do we configure that?
My dbt model's incremental merge strategy isn't deduplicating rows correctly on the unique key -- what's wrong with my Jinja?
Our PySpark job is spilling to disk during a large groupBy aggregation and running for hours -- how do we tune shuffle partitions and diagnose the skew?
Can DuckDB query a Parquet file directly on S3 without spinning up a cluster?
We want to replace a 30GB nightly Spark ETL job with DuckDB to cut infrastructure cost -- how do we structure the COPY/read_parquet pipeline and does dbt-duckdb make sense for local dev?
What's the fastest way to write a MERGE statement in DuckDB's SQL dialect and which extensions do I need to load first?
We need sub-second event processing for fraud detection -- should we go with Kafka, Kinesis, or just stick with our nightly batch loads?
Our Kafka consumer group keeps rebalancing every 30 seconds and lag is climbing -- how do we stabilize it?
Our Kafka consumer group is stuck rebalancing every 30 seconds under the new KIP-848 protocol and lag keeps climbing -- how do we diagnose this?
We're building a notification service and need a message queue for microservices -- should we use Kafka or RabbitMQ for simple pub/sub?
We need to move Salesforce and HubSpot data into Snowflake daily -- should we use Fivetran, ADF, or build something custom with Glue?
Our ADF pipeline's self-hosted integration runtime keeps going offline -- how do we troubleshoot SHIR connectivity?
Our ADF self-hosted integration runtime keeps showing 'offline' in the monitoring hub even though the on-prem VM is running -- how do we troubleshoot SHIR connectivity?
Should we use Azure Data Factory or Fivetran to replicate our SaaS sources into the warehouse?
Our AWS Glue job keeps re-processing files that were already loaded because job bookmarks aren't working -- what's misconfigured with transformation_ctx?
We're on AWS and deciding between Glue and Fivetran for replicating RDS Postgres into Redshift -- which is the better fit?
Our Fivetran connector's Monthly Active Rows spiked this month because a full-refresh table is re-syncing everything -- how do we bring MAR back down?
Should we use Fivetran or Azure Data Factory to sync Salesforce data into our warehouse?
Our Informatica CDI mapping is running slow because pushdown optimization isn't engaging on the Aggregator transformation -- how do we get it to push down to Snowflake?
We're evaluating Informatica IDMC versus Talend for our enterprise integration replatform -- which handles MDM better?
Our NiFi flow is backing up because the connection queue keeps hitting the default back pressure threshold of 10,000 objects -- how do we resize it correctly?
Should we use NiFi or ADF for real-time flow-based routing with full data provenance tracking?
Our Synapse Pipelines trigger shows as published but never fires at the scheduled time -- what are we missing in Synapse Studio?
Is Synapse Pipelines basically the same as ADF, or are there features we'd lose by using it inside our Synapse workspace instead?
Our Talend tMap component is running out of memory doing a 'Load All' lookup against a 50 million row reference table -- how do we fix this without a full redesign?
We're migrating off Talend Open Studio since it was discontinued -- should we move to Fivetran or rebuild in ADF?
